change: Added Trend_Purity to VOL_PHASE_MULTS with EXTREME multiplier 0.3
Killed pump_chain+ signal — only net-negative active signal (13T/30.8%WR/‑bash.29/7d)
Added trend_purity EXTREME penalty to volatility_gate_v2.py — 50% WR in EXTREME, ‑bash.15/7d
SHORT_RSI_FLOOR=30 added — prevent shorting oversold (was catching falling knives)
Increase Trend_Purity EXTREME multiplier from 0.3x to 0.15x
rationale: 10T/40%WR -$0.72/7d trend_purity+ in EXTREME. 5 losers with z>0.6 or RSI>60. 0.3x insufficient. 0.15x further suppresses confidence.

change: Added BAD_TRADE_HOURS set and modified signal_compactor to use set membership
rationale: 7d data: hours 13,14,15,21 are -$2.82 combined. Time-of-day is independent of signal type. Existing time_block missed these.
impact: Expected +$1.50-2.50/7d from blocking marginal entries at bad hours

change: Relaxed pullback-entry- SHORT volatility gate multiplier in HIGH regime from 0.0 to 0.7
rationale: Stale block based on 3 trades with 0%WR. Current 7d data: 20 trades, 65%WR, +$1.01 in HIGH. Multiplier clamped to 0.3 still allowed trades — raising to 0.7 captures more of the edge.

change: Fixed VOL_PHASE_MULTS key mismatch — Pullback_Entry_Short→Pullback_Entry (NORMAL 0.0, HIGH 0.7), R2→R2_Structural (NORMAL 0.5)
before: Keys Pullback_Entry_Short and R2 never matched signal_family() output. Multipliers silently ignored (always 1.0).
after: Keys corrected to Pullback_Entry and R2_Structural. NORMAL blocks pullback-entry (0.0), penalizes rr-struct (0.5). HIGH relaxes pullback-entry (0.7), blocks rr-struct (0.0).
rationale: Bug fix — multipliers were never applied. Pullback-entry SHORT in NORMAL: 15T 53.3%WR -$0.01. rr-struct SHORT in HIGH: 4T 25%WR -$0.41. Key mismatch prevented regime-specific filtering.
impact: ~$0.18/7d from blocked NORMAL pullback-entry trades + reduced HIGH false positives. Net slightly positive.

after: SHORT_NORMAL_PENALTY=0.85 (15% confidence penalty for SHORT in NORMAL)
rationale: SHORT in NORMAL 30T/7d 44%WR -$0.79 — worst regime+direction combo. EXTREME 81.8%WR +$1.74, HIGH 62.5%WR +$1.04.
impact: +$0.20-0.30/7d expected from reduced false SHORT entries in flat markets

change: SHORT_RSI_CEILING=65 added — block SHORT entries when RSI > 65 (overbought)
after: SHORT_RSI_CEILING=65 in hermes_constants.py:801, check in signal_compactor.py:2719-2747
rationale: 20T/7d SHORT RSI>=65 50%WR -$1.02. Overbought SHORT = momentum continuation risk. Only 1 active-signal winner killed (LTC +$0.02 tiny).
impact: +$0.50-1.00/7d expected from blocked overbought SHORT losers

change: Block stale pump-chain+ entries in pump_chain_long.py
before: No is_stale check — stale entries fire freely
after: Skip signal if is_stale=True from token_speeds DB
rationale: 5T stale 7d = 0%WR -$0.73. 0 winners blocked. Other signals (r2_trend, trend_purity) already do this.

change: ATR_SL_MIN 1.2%→1.3% (+ all matched deps: ATR_SL_MIN_INIT, SL_PCT_FALLBACK, TP_PCT_FALLBACK 3.6%→3.9%, STOP_LOSS_DEFAULT, SL_PCT_MIN)
rationale: 55% of below-entry ATR SL hits (11/20) had SL distance 0.34-1.28%, would survive with 1.3% floor. Net: saves $1.62 loss, blocks $0.29 tiny wins. Expected +$1.33/7d.
impact: Reduce ATR_SL triggered exits below entry by ~55%. Trades get 0.1% more room before stop triggers.
